Planned NGET reinforcement at the Iver Grid Supply Point is deferred to ~2029–2030. Under an N-1 event or sustained peak demand period, SSEN may enforce non-firm curtailment on distribution-fed IBX loads, idling colocation customers without physical damage to Equinix plant.

risk_manifestation.mechanism: LD4, LD5, LD6, LD10, and LD13x all pull from the same Slough Trading Estate GSP/SSEN connection. A single constraint event would simultaneously affect multiple customer SLAs across the campus rather than one isolated data hall, amplifying revenue-impact and SLA-breach exposure.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: PD/BI aggregate programmes cover loss per building but do not contain a portfolio-wide curtailment-trigger clause; grid-system correlation is not priced in standard campus placement.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: aggregation_correlation 3/4

grid_posture.dno: UK Power Networks (Dagenham — dedicated 132 kV cable route ~8 km to two UKPN substations)

risk_manifestation.headline: Single ~8 km dedicated 132 kV cable route is the sole transmission path
risk_manifestation.mechanism: LON1's 80 MVA supply depends on an ~8 km bespoke cable route from two UKPN 132 kV substations. A cable fault (dig-in, joint failure) or substation outage at either end causes a total site loss event. Backup diesel generation rated for critical load — a sustained outage beyond generator fuel reserves (typically 72 h) would exhaust backup.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Property/machinery-breakdown cover responds to damage to the cable or switchgear on the insured side; DNO-side outage without physical damage to NTT plant does not trigger standard BI.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: trigger_gap 3/4 — grid-originating outage partially covered only if damage occurs to insured assets

risk_manifestation.headline: Both LON1 buildings share the same dedicated UKPN connection — correlated outage
risk_manifestation.mechanism: LON1A and LON1B both draw from the same dedicated 132 kV route and substations. An event on the UKPN feed simultaneously affects both buildings; colocation revenue from both halls is at risk in a single incident.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Property PD/BI covers individual buildings; a common-cause grid failure hitting both buildings simultaneously is not separately scoped in standard campus wordings.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: aggregation_correlation 3/4

grid_posture.dno: National Grid ESO / UK Power Networks — dual 132 kV direct lines into on-site private dual-primary substation (N+N, 50 MVA); North Two expansion adds incremental capacity

risk_manifestation.headline: All campus buildings share one on-site 50 MVA dual-primary substation
risk_manifestation.mechanism: Telehouse North, East, West, and North Two all feed from the single campus substation taking two 132 kV lines. A substation fault — even with N+N redundancy — that simultaneously damages both primary transformers would cause a full campus outage. Per-building N+1 generators would activate but are not rated for indefinite operation.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Machinery breakdown and PD/BI cover applies to insured plant including on-site substation. Substation damage triggering BI would respond. A DNO-side fault without damage to the on-site substation would not respond under standard BI.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: trigger_gap 2/4 — partial coverage (substation on insured side; DNO-side upstream fault gap remains)

risk_manifestation.headline: All buildings on one Coriander Avenue campus — correlated constraint event
risk_manifestation.mechanism: North, East, West, and North Two buildings are physically co-located, sharing a single geographic constraint boundary. A shared-cause event (substation fault, civil incident, or DNO zone outage) hits all buildings simultaneously; multiple tenant SLAs breach at once.
risk_manifestation.insured_today: Individual building PD/BI; campus-level simultaneous outage not separately sub-limited or scoped in standard wordings.
risk_manifestation.typical_gap: aggregation_correlation 3/4
